newsitem.title: USA: Recycling Industries redeems pfd stock.
newsitem.headline: Recycling Industries redeems pfd stock.

text.p: Recycling Industries Inc said Tuesday it had completed the redemption of its Series C convertible preferred shares.
The companmy also said it expects to report profitable results for the quarter ended June 30.
All 10,000 shares of Series C preferred stock plus accrued dividends were redeemed for $1,344,000, it said.

"By redeeming the Series C convertible preferred stock, we have eliminated the possibility of these shares being converted to common stock and potentially causing equity dilution for our shareholders," said Chief Executive Tom Wiens. "Additionally, the company anticipates reporting profitable results for the quarter just ended last week on June 30, 1997."
The redemption of the Series C stock reduces fully diluted common shares outstanding by 866,318 shares, it said.
The redemption was funded with a combination of cash and debt financing.
